If not, please say so and we'll find another one on our side. Please also note our earlier email attached the inspection report rather than the estimate. For reference, the first estimate (Alder Compliance, dated 3 April 2025) is £1,370.00 in total, with no VAT itemised. It covers painting the bathroom and main room walls and ceiling, replacing the bathroom lino, and repairing the plug socket and shelf. It also covers replacing the bathroom tap. It says the main-room carpet can stay as it is, although we had asked about replacing the burnt carpet. Please treat this as not yet approved; we'll hold it while the comparison is arranged. We'll chase you on 9 April if we haven't heard.
